title: Who will win Nottingham Forest's opening Premier League match of the 2026–27 season?
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : The official Premier League result for Nottingham Forest's first league fixture of the 2026–27 season. 
  Resolution : Resolve according to the result at full time, including stoppage time. Preseason and cup fixtures do not count. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning club's name, or “Draw” if the match finishes level.
